telangana_epass.name: Telangana ePASS Scholarship Portal
telangana_epass.reason: Use the official Government of Telangana ePASS portal to check Post-Matric and Pre-Matric scholarship eligibility and application status.

ap_epass.name: Andhra Pradesh JnanaBhumi Portal
ap_epass.reason: Use the official AP JnanaBhumi portal for post-matric fee reimbursement and scholarship applications.

up_scholarship.name: UP Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Portal
up_scholarship.reason: Use the official Uttar Pradesh scholarship portal for state student welfare schemes.

mahadbt.name: MahaDBT Scholarship Portal
mahadbt.reason: Use the official Government of Maharashtra MahaDBT portal for state scholarships.

scholarship.name: National Scholarship Portal
scholarship.reason: Use the official Government of India portal to check current national scholarship schemes, documents, and application status.

tax_notice.name: Income Tax e-Filing Portal
tax_notice.reason: Use the official Income Tax Department portal to verify tax communications, respond to notices, or check refund status.

utility_bill.name: National Portal of India — Electricity & Utilities
utility_bill.reason: Use the official national portal to locate your state power distribution provider (DISCOM); avoid clicking payment links in unsolicited SMS/WhatsApp messages.

farmer_support.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Portal
farmer_support.reason: Use the official Department of Agriculture portal to check beneficiary status, complete e-KYC, and verify instalment releases.

labour.name: e-Shram National Database of Unorganised Workers
labour.reason: Use the official Ministry of Labour portal for e-Shram card registration, updates, and social security scheme details.

health_scheme.name: National Health Authority (Ayushman Bharat)
health_scheme.reason: Use the official NHA portal to check Ayushman Card eligibility, empaneled hospitals, and PM-JAY coverage.

pension.name: PFRDA & National Pension System (NPS)
pension.reason: Use the official PFRDA website to verify pension schemes, PRAN status, and NPS contributions.

identity_document.name: myAadhaar — UIDAI Portal
identity_document.reason: Use the official UIDAI portal for Aadhaar updates and enrolment status; never share OTPs with unverified calls.

education_admission.name: University Grants Commission (UGC)
education_admission.reason: Use the official UGC portal to verify university recognitions, entrance announcements, and academic notices.

grievance.name: CPGRAMS Public Grievance Redressal Portal
grievance.reason: Use the official Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System to file or track grievances with any department.

general_notice.name: National Portal of India
general_notice.reason: Use the official Government of India portal to verify department details before taking action on any notice.
